audience: farms, property managers and anyone who runs WeatherLink weather stations

useCases.title: Find stations and sensors that stopped reporting
useCases.text: List your stations and sensors, then check the last reporting time of each sensor. Use the result to find the ones that went quiet.

useCases.title: Read the current weather at one station
useCases.text: Find the station id, then get the latest observation per sensor, such as temperature, humidity, wind and rain. The record age depends on your WeatherLink access level.

useCases.title: Review rainfall and temperature for a past day
useCases.text: Get the historic records of one station for a window of up to 24 hours. Each record time marks the end of its recording interval. Your WeatherLink subscription must include historic data.

useCases.title: Plan irrigation with evapotranspiration data
useCases.text: Get the evapotranspiration data of a WeatherLink Live station. Only WeatherLink Live stations report this data.

useCases.title: Inventory the nodes and sensors of your account
useCases.text: List the nodes and sensors that your API Key can access, with their metadata. Use the list to see what each station reports.
